<!--
This is the failure class this project exists for: nothing errored, nothing turned red,
and yet the work did not happen. Those cases are hard to describe, so a rough
description is completely fine — post it even if you're not sure it's the same thing.
-->

**What claimed success**
<!-- e.g. an agent, a scheduled job, a CI step, a monitor -->

**What you expected to exist afterwards**
<!-- a file, a row, a message, a deploy — anything you could have checked -->

**How you found out it hadn't happened**
<!-- or: you haven't confirmed yet, you just don't trust it. That's a valid answer. -->

**Anything green that shouldn't have been**
<!-- dashboard, health check, test suite, status field -->

Not a bug report? Also welcome here:

- Drop a GitHub repo link and ask what it actually does and whether it's worth adopting.
  We check whether it's alive (recent commits, issue response, real adoption) rather than
  just summarising the README — and we'll say so plainly if it looks abandoned.

- Tell us about a silent failure shape we haven't catalogued. We keep a running list of
